_doc: Real bus (register type + register paint) -> custom Czech pak128 object in VZ-DPMostLitvinov-bus.pak. First matching rule wins; 'paint_contains' narrows a rule to one register paint. 'chain' = every object in order (articulated buses are two objects); 'core' = the name shown in the vehicle cell (the first object's last segment). status 'exists' = in the pak source tree (C:/Users/vojte/Developer/simutrans-custom-czech-pak128/build/VZ-DPMostLitvinov-bus/*.dat, main b84c15c, read 29 Sep 2026); status 'requested' = not in the pak yet, asked for in pak_request.md; the sheet shows the object being made, marked 'requested', never a stand-in from another city. Advertising wraps (register paint 'CVR ...') map to the type's normal livery (brief rule e).
